d:
A raw, high-voltage anthem straight from the heart of Majha, Baddest Majhail sees Sardar Khehra at his most fearless. With bars like “Phone mera laga rehnda 24 ghante tap te” and “Gall asle di karde te modela te marde”, he brings street credibility and regional pride into sharp focus. The beat hits hard, the flow is relentless, and every line reaffirms his position as the loudest voice in Punjab's trap-rap scene. This is for the hustlers, the outsiders, the ones who never folded.
Title: Baddest Majhail
Artist: Sardar Khehra
Producer: RASS
Lyrics: Sardar Khehra
Composer: Sardar Khehra x rass
